Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sweet Treats Confectionery specializes in the retail of a wide variety of candy and confectionery items, including chocolates, gummies, licorice, and seasonal treats. Our operations include an inviting storefront that encourages customer interaction through product sampling and themed displays. We also offer workshops on candy-making, ensuring that all activities are conducted with a focus on safety. Our products are sourced from reputable suppliers, and we implement inventory management practices to minimize hazards. We maintain an online presence with e-commerce capabilities, supported by cybersecurity measures to protect customer data.
